content: {"summary":"Customers report frequent missed or misplaced deliveries, often without prior notification or proper signature confirmation [#tk_2913200]. Many complain that packages are left in insecure or inappropriate locations, such as on doorsteps or in letterboxes, increasing theft risk [#tk_470776][#tk_2747237]. Delivery personnel sometimes fail to follow instructions, leaving items unattended or even discarding them, leading to frustration and loss of trust [#tk_2853668][#tk_2850762]. Service delays and lack of customer support exacerbate dissatisfaction, especially when promised delivery windows are missed [#tk_2061551][#tk_451859]."}
